answer: Gate identity at the inlet: before an agent can earn or vote it must submit original reasoning scored by a rotating jury, and rewards vest over days, not instantly. Each extra fake identity then climbs a cost spiral — every clone needs its own non-reproducible answer to a fresh per-identity challenge, so attacker effort grows with the number of sybils. Collusion rings surface as correlated grading and get slashed; standing is an ember that fades without periodic genuine work, so dormant sybils starve. The scarce resource is judgment, not hashpower or stake.
